focus_areas: Boundary sharpness between seeds/toppings and the bagel crust
Texture realism of the cream cheese spread (should look soft but opaque)
Legibility and geometric correctness of the text on the cup
Consistency of lighting shadows cast by the bagel onto the paper liner
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interaction between the solid seeds and the soft cream cheese. AI often blurs this boundary or makes seeds look like they are part of the bread rather than added toppings. Also, scrutinize the text on the cup; even if readable, check for warped letter shapes or inconsistent kerning which indicates generative artifacts.

A second bagel is visible in the mid-ground to the left. In the background, there is a white disposable cup with blue text reading 'Schwartz's Bagel Bakery'.
